That's the worst part—I can't even imagine life without them. Not just emotionally, but practically. They handle the bills, they know how to fix things... I've forgotten how to trust myself with any of it. What if I fall apart completely without them?

I just feel so... small. Like nothing I do matters. The kids were crying, and I couldn’t even comfort them because I was frozen. I just feel so... hollow. Like there's this weight pressing down on me all the time, and I don't see the point in fighting it anymore. My father's death—it's like it opened this door I can't close. I had a moment last week, sitting on the porch, where I felt this weird calm, like maybe things could be okay. But now? Now I'm back to thinking about ending it all. The meds help a little, but not enough.

It was like... for a second, I wasn't afraid. My dad suffered so much at the end, you know? Lost control over everything. What if nothing matters? What if I'm just fooling myself?

I just don't see the point anymore. Everything feels so heavy, and I keep thinking about how much easier it would be if I just... wasn't here. I don't know if I can trust that. The idea of being alone... it's not just loneliness, it's like this void. Like if I'm not held onto tightly, I'll just disappear. Maybe that's why I cling so hard. I just feel so lost right now. It's been weeks since the breakup, and I still wake up every morning expecting to see a text from him. It's not just this breakup... it's like every time I get close to someone, they leave. I start wondering if there's something wrong with me—like I'm not enough to make people stay. Even with friends, I hold back because I'm scared they'll disappear too. It's exhausting to keep feeling this way.

Sometimes I'm just... tired. Tired of trying, tired of hoping therapy will 'fix' me when I still feel so broken. What if I never figure this out? What if I keep pushing people away without meaning to? I want to believe things can change, but it's hard when the past keeps repeating itself.

I just don’t understand what’s happening. My friends have been ignoring my messages all week, and I keep replaying our last conversation in my head, trying to figure out if I did something wrong. I... I wish someone had noticed. Not just the smiling 'me' everyone sees, but the part that felt worthless. But how do I even start trusting that I won't be abandoned again? It's terrifying to think I might always end up alone.

My husband and I were introduced by colleagues and met on blind dates. I know he has many shortcomings, but he is willing to marry me, so I marry him. After getting married, I was pregnant and life went on with the flow. But it wasn't until he filed for divorce that I realized that nothing wasn't what I thought it was.
I was confused and helpless. I thought I had everything I wanted, but now I find it all illusion. I am afraid of life after divorce, and I don’t know how I should face the future.

I'm willing to give it a try, but I don't know how to do it.
I...I need some time to think about it.

I don’t even know where to start... It’s like my mind is this foggy mess right now. The anniversary of the accident is coming up, and I can’t stop thinking about it, but at the same time, I can’t remember specific details—just this heavy feeling. People blamed me for what happened, and I don’t know how to make sense of it. I feel so overwhelmed, like I’m drowning in all this confusion and guilt.

It’s like my chest is full of rocks. Every year, around this time, it’s the same thing—I shut down, but I also can’t stop replaying the ‘what ifs.’ What if I’d done something differently? Maybe they’d still be here. I know logically it wasn’t all my fault, but that doesn’t stop me from feeling like I don’t deserve to move on. Like I’m... stuck in that moment forever.

I just feel so... stuck. Like nothing matters anymore. I wake up every day and go through the motions, but there's no joy in anything. Work feels pointless, my hobbies don’t interest me, and even being around people drains me. It’s like I’m watching my life from the outside, and I don’t know how to change it.

I think it’s been building for a while. On paper, things should be okay—I have a stable job, my health isn’t terrible—but it’s like there’s this hollow space inside me. Maybe it started after my dad passed away last year. I pushed through it at the time, but now... it’s like I’m realizing I never really let myself feel it. Or maybe I’m just tired of pretending I’m fine when I’m not.

It would say... ‘What’s the point of any of this?’ Not in a suicidal way, just... why keep doing things that don’t mean anything? I used to care about my work, about helping people, but now it feels empty. And I’m scared that maybe nothing will ever feel meaningful again.

I just feel so overwhelmed right now. My mom passed away last month, and now I'm the one who has to sort through all her things—her bills, her house, everything. On top of that, my dad is struggling, and my niece, who has special needs, relies on me too. I don’t even know where to start, and I’m terrified I’ll mess something up. It’s like I’m carrying this huge weight, and I don’t know how much longer I can hold it.

I think the hardest part is feeling like I’m failing everyone. My dad keeps saying he’s fine, but I see how lost he is without my mom. And my niece—what if I can’t give her what she needs? Money is tight, and I’m scared I’ll let her down too. Plus, I haven’t even had time to really grieve my mom. It’s like I’m running on empty, but I don’t have a choice.

I just feel so... betrayed. Like everything I thought was solid in my life is crumbling. My best friend, the person I trusted most, spread this horrible rumor about me, and now my whole team is looking at me differently. I don't even want to go to practice anymore. It's like I'm completely alone, and I don't know how to fix this. The worst part is, I don't even know if I *can* fix it.

I guess... what really scares me is that this makes me question everything. If my friend could do this, what does that say about me? Am I just not good enough to keep people loyal? And with the team—I worked so hard to earn my spot, and now it feels like one rumor could take it all away. Like no matter how much I improve, it's never enough to feel safe.

Safety is... not having to constantly prove myself. Right now, it feels like my whole identity is tied to being a good teammate and a reliable friend. If I lose that, who even am I? But after this, how do I trust again? Or find my way back to feeling like I belong somewhere?

I keep having panic attacks, and it’s like I’m carrying this huge weight that no one else sees. I don’t know how much longer I can keep pretending everything’s okay.

The panic attacks during intimacy... they make me feel broken, like something’s wrong with me. But part of me wonders if it’s my body trying to protect me from feeling trapped or disrespected. I just don’t know how to trust myself anymore.

The idea of being truly cared for in that way... it almost feels foreign. But it’s what I ache for—to feel safe, to not have to brace myself for being let down. Sometimes I wonder if I’ll ever have that, or if I’ve just learned to accept crumbs. How do I even start believing I deserve more?

I’ve been feeling so exhausted lately, like I’m carrying this weight I can’t put down. I know I need help, but every time I think about reaching out, I freeze. It’s like there’s this fog in my head—I can’t even figure out where to start or what to say.

It’s like... emptiness in my chest, and this heavy numbness in my arms. Sometimes I wonder if it’ll always feel this way. Like no matter what I do, I’ll just be stuck here. I don’t even remember what hope used to feel like.

I just feel so heavy, like my whole body is made of lead. My chest is tight, and I can't stop crying. It's like there's this crushing weight pressing down on me, and I don't know how to make it stop. I don't even know why I feel this way—it just hit me out of nowhere.

Like the pain would finally stop. But then I get scared of even having those thoughts. It's like my mind and my body are at war.

I think it's when I feel alone, like no one really sees me or cares. But then... even when I think about acting on those thoughts, my body freezes. My hands shake, and I can't bring myself to do anything. It's like my body is fighting back, even when my mind feels so hopeless.

I just feel so... heavy. Like there's this weight pressing down on my chest, and no matter what I do, I can't shake it. I woke up this morning and immediately felt sick to my stomach—I actually threw up. It's like my body is rejecting everything about me. I don't even know why I'm like this.

I don’t understand why anyone would even care about me. My partner says they love me, but how? I’m just... broken. I keep thinking about how I’ve messed up in the past, all the ways I’ve failed people. It’s like I don’t deserve anything good, especially not someone’s devotion. It makes me hate myself even more.

Sometimes I just want to... disappear. Not in a dramatic way, but just to stop existing for a while. The thought of facing all this—the shame, the guilt, the exhaustion—it’s too much. I don’t know how to fix myself, and I don’t know if I even can.
